{{nihongo|'''Sabi Shrine'''|佐備神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Kawachi Province]].

'''Sabi Shrine''' (さびじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Tondabayashi|ar|تونداباياشي (أوساكا)|ca|Tondabayashi|ce|Тондабаяси|ceb|Tondabayashi Shi|cs|Tondabajaši|de|Tondabayashi|eo|Tondabajaŝi|es|Tondabayashi (Osaka)|et|Tondabayashi|fa|توندابایاشی، اوساکا|fi|Tondabayashi|fr|Tondabayashi|gl|Tondabayashi|hy|Տոնդաբայասի|it|Tondabayashi|ja|富田林市|ko|돈다바야시시|mzn|توندابایاشی، اوساکا|nl|Tondabayashi|no|Tondabayashi|pl|Tondabayashi|pt|Tondabayashi|ro|Tondabayashi|ru|Тондабаяси|sco|Tondabayashi|sh|Tondabayashi|simple|Tondabayashi|sr|Тондабајаши|sv|Tondabayashi|tg|Тондабаяши|th|ทนดาบายาชิ|tl|Tondabayashi, Osaka|tr|Tondabayashi|tt|Тондабаяси|uk|Тондабаяші|ur|ٹونڈا بایا شی|vi|Tondabayashi, Ōsaka|war|Tondabayashi|zh|富田林市|zh_classical|富田林市|zh_min_nan|Tondabayasi-chhī|zh_yue|富田林|qid=Q490928}}, {{ill|Osaka Prefecture|Q122723|qid=Q122723}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}, and its former {{ill|Shakaku|Q10444029|qid=Q10444029}} was {{ill|Son-sha|ja|村社|qid=Q134917284}}.

=== Enshrined deities ===
;Main deity
*{{ill|Futodama|it|Futodama|ja|フトダマ|ru|Футодама|simple|Futodama|zh|布刀玉命|qid=Q11059539|lt=Ame-no-Futodama-no-Mikoto}}

;Left side hall
*{{ill|Matsunoo Taisha|Q710302|qid=Q710302|lt=Matsuo Ōkami}}
**{{ill|Ōyamatsumi|lt=Ōyamatsumi|Q386563|qid=Q386563|lt=Ōyamazumi-no-Kami}}
**Nakatsushima-hime-no-Kami

;Right side hall
*{{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|Q11088805|qid=Q11088805|lt=Kasuga Ōkami}}
**{{ill|Takemikazuchi|lt=Takemikazuchi|Q1502690|qid=Q1502690|qid=Q1502690|lt=Takemikazuchi-no-Mikoto}}
**{{ill|Futsunushi|lt=Futsunushi-no-Kami|Q1107286|qid=Q1107286|lt=Ihahinushi-no-Mikoto}}
**{{ill|Ame-no-Koyane|Q2564508|qid=Q2564508|lt=Ame-no-Koyane-no-Mikoto}}
**{{ill|Himegami|Q22070227|qid=Q22070227}}

Although the honden is in sansha-zukuri form, documents only listed Ame-no-Futodama-no-Mikoto and Matsuo Ōkami, leaving one deity unknown; however, a repair wooden tag from year 6 of {{ill|Kanbun (era)|Q1146228|qid=Q1146228}} saying "left Matsuo Daimyōjin, right Kasuga Daimyōjin" confirmed Kasuga Ōkami in the right hall.

=== History ===
Shrine tradition places its founding in the first month of {{ill|Ten'an|Q1075611|qid=Q1075611|lt=Ten'an}} 2 ({{ill|858|Q30371|qid=Q30371}}). This area was Sabi-gō in Ishikawa District, where the Sami clan, descended from the {{ill|Inbe clan|Q8189229|qid=Q8189229}}, lived, and Ame-no-Futodama-no-Mikoto is thought to have been enshrined as ancestral deity.

It is listed as "Sabi Shrine" in {{ill|Ishikawa district|ja|石川郡 (大阪府)|zh|石川郡 (大阪府)|qid=Q11586399|lt=Ishikawa District}} of {{ill|Kawachi Province|be|Каваты (правінцыя)|ca|Província de Kawachi|ckb|پارێزگای کاواچی|cs|Provincie Kawači|de|Provinz Kawachi|es|Provincia de Kawachi|fa|ولایت کاواچی|fr|Province de Kawachi|gl|Provincia de Kawachi|hak|Kawachi-koet|id|Provinsi Kawachi|it|Kawachi (provincia)|ja|河内国|ko|가와치국|lt|Kavačio žemė|nl|Kawachi (provincie)|pt|Província de Kawachi|ru|Кавати (провинция)|simple|Kawachi Province|sk|Kawači (provincia)|sr|Провинција Кавачи|tr|Kawachi (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Каваті|zh|河內國|zh_min_nan|Kawati-kok|zh_yue|河內國|qid=Q1047150}} in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}} and ranked as small shrine. It was ranked as village shrine in Meiji 5 and designated a heihaku-offering shrine in Taishō 1.
